verdict.rationale: Capacities documents itself as an offline-first app: you can work offline, changes sync when you reconnect, and search works offline on all devices. Readable ownership outside the app comes only through exports, which can be scheduled and produce human- and machine-readable Markdown with front matter plus CSV files, rather than notes living natively in local files. missing for 10: notes stored natively as local files or an open, readable local-first store; evidence that every feature (not just editing and search) works fully offline; independent or hands-on corroboration of offline behavior.
